services.scope: Prepare the data Marketo Optimizer's AI decisioning reads: define up to 10 personas from your client's person attributes in the persona mapping panel, set and activate the intent model's activity weights with Coworker's Intent configuration skill and check the results with Analyze intent, then use AI-decisioning health to find coverage gaps across demographic, firmographic, technographic, psychographic, persona and intent data and agree an enrichment plan for them.
services.adobe_quote: Closing those gaps improves how AI decisioning scores and routes each person.

source.title: Experience League: AI-Decisioning Health (Marketo Optimizer)

connection_how: Coworker is the chat panel inside Marketo Optimizer. Your marketers describe what they need or upload a campaign brief, and Coworker sets up the program, lists and journeys for them to review. It can only do what each person's permissions allow, and it creates nothing until that person says to go ahead.
product_facts: Coworker is Adobe's AI-powered teammate for customer experience and marketing workflows. You describe a goal in plain language, and it plans the work, executes it across your Adobe and connected systems, validates the results and brings the finished work back for your approval.
Coworker lets your teams ask for insights, content and actions across your Adobe applications in natural language.

We would tailor Coworker to the way your teams work with skills: reusable playbooks that standardize common workflows, reporting methods and analysis approaches, so nobody has to explain the same process again.

You keep control through approval gates, permissions inherited from your Adobe organization, checks before actions run and an audit trail. Skills do not store customer data: data access stays governed through your connected Adobe applications, permissions and organizational controls.
Coworker acts across Adobe and external systems through governed access, using built-in connectors or your own. An external tool or service is connected by adding it as a server.
As Coworker takes on a task you can watch it reason and progress. It validates the results and brings the finished work back to you for approval.
AI-decisioning health checks the data that powers personalization in Adobe Marketo Optimizer.
Next to the highlights, a radar chart plots overall Coverage across six dimensions: demographic, firmographic, technographic, psychographic, persona, and intent.
Only one model can be Active at any time: the one currently driving the scoring.
Saving prompts you to activate the model now. Confirming replaces the current Active model, which is demoted automatically.
Intent reports require the View B2B Intent Reports permission.
You can have up to 20 personas defined in the Persona mapping list.
Open the Persona mapping panel from the Coworker chat interface.
